# Import a ClearView model

[Español](clearview-import-es.md) · [English](clearview-import-en.md) · [Português](clearview-import-pt.md) · [简体中文](clearview-import-zh-Hans.md) · [Deutsch](clearview-import-de.md) · [Русский](clearview-import-ru.md) · [Français](clearview-import-fr.md) · [Italiano](clearview-import-it.md) · [日本語](clearview-import-ja.md) · [한국어](clearview-import-ko.md) · [العربية](clearview-import-ar.md)

Use a development build with **ClearView aircraft ZIP** in the file picker. The website’s v0.2.7 download does not include ZIP import.

**Preview and drafts only.** Imported models cannot yet fly or be saved as flyable aircraft.

## Where to download

- [ClearView community models](https://rcflightsim.com/models.html): airplane ZIPs and Ken Northup’s Plane Packs.
- [Gary Gunnerson’s models](https://gunnerson.homestead.com/files/clearview_models.htm): choose the ClearView downloads.

Tested example: [MC Extra 330 Red](https://time2rc.s3.amazonaws.com/mc-models/RP17/MC_3D_Hobby_Shops_Extra_330_Red.zip).

## Three steps

1. Download the model’s `.zip` and keep it zipped.
2. Open **Workshop → Create aircraft… → Import → Choose model…**. Select the ZIP; for a pack, choose one aircraft.
3. Check the preview and messages, name it, then select **Save draft**. Reopen it with **Open…**. Keep the original ZIP.

## Which files work?

Complete **ClearView v5/v6 airplane ZIPs**, up to **64 MiB**: `params.txt`, its referenced `.ac` model and textures in their original folders. Repaints need the complete model.

## Limits

ClearView flight physics is not transferred. Helicopters, scenery, raw FMS files and `.lst` lists are outside this workflow. Missing textures or unsupported images/geometry can block preview; read the message and try another complete ZIP.

Keep the author’s credits and respect each model’s license.
